title: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) Networking & Security — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces private VM outbound internet egress: from private RFC 1918 compute instance through Cloud NAT gateway to external SaaS APIs.
routing_rationale: Cloud NAT provides managed outbound source IP translation, allowing private VMs to download software updates without exposing inbound attack surfaces.

nodes.label: Private VM (10.1.0.5)
nodes.detail: Application instance without external public IP address.

nodes.label: Andromeda vSwitch
nodes.detail: Encapsulates packet; consults VPC route table for 0.0.0.0/0 default route.

nodes.label: Cloud NAT Gateway
nodes.detail: Replaces private source IP and port with public NAT IP and allocated port.

nodes.label: External SaaS Service
nodes.detail: Receives authorized API call originating from verified Cloud NAT static IP.

steps.title: Firewall Rule Validation
steps.action: VPC firewall verifies outbound TCP port 443 is permitted.
steps.why_traversal: Egress firewall rules enforce defense-in-depth against data exfiltration.

steps.title: Route Table Lookup
steps.action: Andromeda vSwitch matches 0.0.0.0/0 next-hop default internet gateway.
steps.why_traversal: Directs outbound packet to Cloud NAT for source address translation.

steps.title: SNAT Translation & Egress
steps.action: Cloud NAT allocates port 12048 and transmits packet to api.stripe.com.
steps.why_traversal: Vendor sees static Google Cloud IP; replies return along stateful reverse mapping.

scenarios.label: Egress Firewall Deny Rule Triggered
scenarios.root_cause: Default egress deny rule blocked unauthorized outbound port 22 / 8080.
scenarios.diverted_path: Packet dropped silently at vNIC boundary; VPC Flow Log captures denial.
scenarios.blast_radius: Only unauthorized ports blocked; approved port 443 traffic continues.
scenarios.recovery: Create explicit egress firewall rule allowing target destination CIDR and port.
